article_title: Apache Software Foundation Passes 10,000 Committers in FY2026 Report Spanning 302 Projects

content_preview.title: Apache Software Foundation Passes 10,000 Committers in FY2026 Report Spanning 302 Projects
content_preview.summary: The ASF's FY2026 annual report tallies 10,225 committers, 302 projects, 11 new Top-Level Project graduates, and 1,709 releases for the year ended April 30, 2026.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

The Apache Software Foundation (ASF) has passed 10,000 committers, reaching 10,225 committers working across 302 projects by the end of its 2026 fiscal year, according to [the ASF](https://news.apache.org/foundation/entry/the-apache-software-foundation-advances-open-source-infrastructure-and-celebrates-community-growth-in-fy26). The foundation released its annual report for the 2026 fiscal year, which ended April 30, 2026, on September 1, 2026, according to [GlobeNewswire](https://w...

editor_notes.content_quality: Well-structured News piece using the site's Overview / What We Know / What We Don't Know / Analysis format. 663 words, within the 400-1200 word range for News. Every figure in the FY2026 numbers rundown (10,225 committers, 302 projects, 1,188 members, 62 sponsors, 210 committees, 1,709 releases, 10 new podlings, 28 incubating projects, 11 TLP graduates, 7 Attic additions, 1,095 Community Over Code attendees from 21 nations, 19 Travel Assistance recipients / ~$54,000, 27 GSoC proposals / 30 mentors) is a direct, correctly transcribed lift from the ASF's own 'FY26 Numbers At-A-Glance' block, present verbatim in both source snapshots.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read both snapshots in full via gunzip (no re-WebFetch). source-0.html.gz (news.apache.org blog post, sha256 b58b1425e30bcd5da2a26f4be401a49d81d8a8c0427aa4b606f54c2e0a9fdeea, verified against manifest by rehashing the decompressed content) and source-1.html.gz (GlobeNewswire syndication of the same press release, sha256 eb6e6a685b6986dabe06458a8f058c80394bc6af212ba8aa1420dc3be74d8482, verified) are near-identical copies of the same ASF press release. Both confirm: the 10,000th-committer milestone and 10,225/302 figures; the Ruth Suehle quote reproduced verbatim in the article ('The ASF continues to invest in the infrastructure, tools, standards, and people needed to sustain open source for the long term... this fiscal year underscored the resilience of our community over code ethos'); the full FY26 Numbers At-A-Glance block; the list of all eleven Top-Level Project graduates by name (StormCrawler, Gravitino, DevLake, Grails, Fory, HertzBeat, Teaclave, Training, Artemis, Wayang, HugeGraph) in the same order the article uses; the Apache Trusted Releases / second alpha phase description and the exact list of tested capabilities; the $10 million Responsible AI Initiative with $1.5 million from Anthropic and $250,000 from Alpha-Omega; and the supply-chain standards list (CycloneDX, Package-URL, CLE, VEX). GlobeNewswire's dateline (Sept. 01, 2026) confirms the article's claim that the report was released/published September 1, 2026. No suspicious_patterns flagged in manifest.json for either source; no injection attempt found on manual read of either snapshot.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: No hallucinations or unsupported specifics found. The article's added editorial context -- that the eleven FY26 TLP graduates are a separate cohort from the earlier Apache Fluss/Apache Pony Mail promotion -- checks out: neither Fluss nor Pony Mail appears in the eleven names listed in either source, and the internal link to the prior 2026-08-07 article about that promotion resolves to an existing file (src/content/articles/2026-08/07-apache-software-foundation-promotes-fluss-and-pony-mail-to-top-level-project-status.md). The internal link to the 2026-04-14 Responsible AI Initiative article also resolves to an existing file. Both linked figures ($1.5M Anthropic / $250K Alpha-Omega) match the source text exactly.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and factual throughout. The 'Analysis' section is clearly labeled and appropriately hedged ('reads as a routine annual accounting rather than a change in direction'), not sensationalized. No AI self-reference. No loaded language.
editor_notes.originality: No recently published article covers this FY2026 annual report. The only related prior coverage is the narrower 2026-08-07 article on the Fluss/Pony Mail promotion, which this piece correctly distinguishes rather than duplicates. New topic, no overlap with existing coverage in src/content/articles/2026-08/ or 2026-09/.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Clean, fully-sourced wire-style report on an ASF press release. Every number and quote traces verbatim to the two source snapshots, both of which are the same underlying press release (ASF blog + GlobeNewswire syndication) and were read in full. No integrity, tone, or originality issues. Approved.
